name: Silver Tongue
description: A wrestler with elite Charisma (5+) holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.charisma >= 5 && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Brawler King
description: A wrestler with elite Brawl (5+) holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.brawl >= 5 && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Driven to the Top
description: A wrestler with elite Drive (5+) holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.drive >= 5 && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Unbreakable
description: A wrestler with elite Resilience (5+) holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.resilience >= 5 && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: The Complete Package
description: Have a wrestler with Drive, Resilience, Charisma, and Brawl all at 4 or higher
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.drive >= 4 && w.resilience >= 4 && w.charisma >= 4 && w.brawl >= 4 }

name: Glass Cannon Champion
description: A low-health wrestler (starting health 8 or below) holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.startingHealth <= 8 && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Iron Lungs
description: A high-stamina wrestler (starting stamina 16 or above) holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.startingStamina >= 16 && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Bag of Tricks
description: A wrestler with a near-full deck (17+ cards) holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.deckSize >= 17 && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Global Scouting Report
description: Have active wrestlers from three or more different heritage regions
unlockCondition: wrestlers.findAll { it.heritageTag && it.active }.collect { it.heritageTag }.unique().size() >= 3

name: Hometown Pride
description: Have two or more current champions all from the same heritage region
unlockCondition: def champs = wrestlers.findAll { w -> w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }; champs.size() >= 2 && champs.every { it.heritageTag } && champs.collect { it.heritageTag }.unique().size() == 1

name: Homegrown Champion
description: A custom-expansion wrestler holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.expansionCode == 'CUSTOM' && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: The Glass Ceiling, Shattered
description: A female wrestler holds a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.gender?.name() == 'FEMALE' && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Olympic Gold
description: Have Kurt Angle win a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('angle') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: A Giant Among Champions
description: Have André the Giant hold a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('andr') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Macho Madness
description: Have Randy Savage hold a championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('savage') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Whole Damn Show
description: Have Rob Van Dam appear in both a promo and the main event of the same weekly show
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('mainEventParticipants') && mainEventParticipants?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('van dam') } && promoParticipants?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('van dam') }

name: Five Star Frog Splash
description: Have Rob Van Dam win a five-star match with his signature Frog Splash
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('winningCardName') && (isWinner ?: false) && participant?.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('van dam') && winningCardName?.toLowerCase()?.contains('frog splash') && (segmentRating ?: 0) >= 100

name: Mr. Monday Night
description: Have Rob Van Dam successfully defend a championship four weeks in a row
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('van dam') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign && (r.consecutiveWeeklyDefenses ?: 0) >= 4 } }

name: Rob... Van... Dam
description: Have Rob Van Dam reach Icon tier
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('van dam') && w.defaultState?.map { s -> s.tier?.name() == 'ICON' }?.orElse(false) }

name: The Almighty
description: Have Bobby Lashley win a world championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('lashley') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Hurt Lock
description: Have Bobby Lashley win a match with his signature Hurt Lock submission
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('winningCardName') && (isWinner ?: false) && participant?.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('lashley') && winningCardName?.toLowerCase()?.contains('hurt lock')

name: Pain Is Profitable
description: Have Bobby Lashley win 5 consecutive matches
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('lashley') && (w.consecutiveWins ?: 0) >= 5 }

name: The Collective Rises
description: Have both Bobby Lashley and Shelton Benjamin hold titles at the same time
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('lashley') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } } && wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('benjamin') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Eat. Defeat. Repeat.
description: Have Gail Kim win 3 consecutive matches
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('gail') && (w.consecutiveWins ?: 0) >= 3 }

name: TNA Original
description: Have Gail Kim win a championship for the first time
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('gail') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign && (r.reignNumber ?: 1) == 1 } }

name: Submission Artist
description: Have Gail Kim win a match with her signature Koji Clutch submission
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('winningCardName') && (isWinner ?: false) && participant?.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('gail') && winningCardName?.toLowerCase()?.contains('koji')

name: The Standard
description: Have Gail Kim hold a championship for 90 or more days
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('gail') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign && java.time.Duration.between(r.startDate, java.time.Instant.now()).toDays() >= 90 } }

name: The Blueprint
description: Have Dynamite Kid put on a five-star match
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('segmentRating') && (isWinner ?: false) && participant?.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('dynamite') && (segmentRating ?: 0) >= 100

name: Gold at Last
description: Have Dynamite Kid win a world championship
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('dynamite') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Dynamite & Bulldog
description: Have Dynamite Kid and The British Bulldog hold titles at the same time
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('dynamite') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } } && wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('bulldog') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: Can Anyone Keep Up?
description: Have Dynamite Kid win a match with dominant momentum
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('winnerMomentum') && (isWinner ?: false) && participant?.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('dynamite') && (winnerMomentum ?: 0) >= 7

name: Absolutely Iconic

name: The IIconics
description: Have Cassie Lee and Jessie McKay hold titles at the same time
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('cassie') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } } && wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('jessie') && w.reigns?.any { r -> r.currentReign } }

name: It Came From Nowhere
description: Have Cassie Lee win a match with her spinning heel kick
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('winningCardName') && (isWinner ?: false) && participant?.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('cassie') && winningCardName?.toLowerCase()?.contains('heel kick')

name: Stealing the Show
description: Have Cassie Lee appear in a promo and win the main event of the same show
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('mainEventParticipants') && mainEventParticipants?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('cassie') } && promoParticipants?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('cassie') }

name: Latino Heat
description: Have Eddie Guerrero reach Icon tier
unlockCondition: wrestlers?.any { w -> w.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('eddie') && w.defaultState?.map { s -> s.tier?.name() == 'ICON' }?.orElse(false) }

name: Frog Splash
description: Have Eddie Guerrero win a five-star match with his signature Frog Splash
unlockCondition: binding.hasVariable('winningCardName') && (isWinner ?: false) && participant?.name?.toLowerCase()?.contains('eddie') && winningCardName?.toLowerCase()?.contains('frog splash') && (segmentRating ?: 0) >= 100

name: ¡Viva la Raza!
